about: Curated stops for the New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island legs and their links to Rivière-du-Loup and Bangor, placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. A stop whose season is not 'year round' is left out.

truck_access.about: Stops whose tractor-trailer access was read from a source, and those where it is assumed with the reason in source. The Irving Big Stops read it from the operator; the cardlocks from their names; Woodstock and Lancaster from OpenStreetMap truck tags. The town stations at the city ends have no source either way.

stops.name: Grand Falls Big Stop
stops.source: Position read from the operator page; Highway 2 exit 75, diesel pumps listed by the operator with DEF at the pump, driver lounge, showers and laundry (https://www.irvingoil.com/fr-CA/location/irving-oil-25801, read 2026-11-22). Overnight truck parking and showers at Big Stops read from Irving Oil's professional driver benefits sheet (https://www.irvingoil.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/FT25-016%20MC%20Email%20Lifecycle%20-%20Driver%20Benefits%20-%20PDF_0.pdf, read 2026-11-22). Open around the clock read from the page. Leg mile projected onto the leg's archived road.

stops.name: Petro-Pass Grand Falls
stops.source: Position read from OSM node 833420459 (Petro-Pass), OpenStreetMap planet extract 2026-11-16. Petro-Pass is Petro-Canada's commercial truck fuel network, so truck access is read from the name; a cardlock sells to account holders, so fuel is its only action. Open year round assumed. Leg mile projected onto the leg's archived road.
